# Catalog

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.sh from modules/components; do not edit. -->

The framework ships the components below. Enable one with a
`[components.<name>]` table in `workstation.toml` (see
[workstation-toml.md](workstation-toml.md)); `dotsteward init --components`
takes the same names. Anything else is a private component of your instance,
written against the same contract (see [concepts.md](concepts.md)).

| Component | What it provides |
| --- | --- |
| [`apt-policy`](components/apt-policy.md) | The system files that bind the other drivers of apt (unattended-upgrades, the software updaters, a plain `apt upgrade`) to what `dotsteward upgrade` does with the kernel and driver classes. Linux only, method `system`. |
| [`claude-code`](components/claude-code.md) | Claude Code, the coding agent CLI (`claude`), on Linux and darwin, with its agent rules file, skill link root, settings targets and, optionally, Claude Code plugins and a launch environment. |
| [`codex`](components/codex.md) | The Codex CLI (`codex`), its agent rules link, its configuration file as a settings target, its legacy skill root and, optionally, Codex plugins. |
| [`craft-anything`](components/craft-anything.md) | Craft Anything, an application that explains how software works and helps build your own, from the official DEB that each GitHub release of [storytold/craft-anything](https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything) carries, kept up to date through the local APT bridge with plain `apt update && apt upgrade`. |
| [`deckcraft`](components/deckcraft.md) | DeckCraft, a presentation and slide show application, from the official DEB that each GitHub release of [storytold/deckcraft](https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft) carries, kept up to date through the local APT bridge with plain `apt update && apt upgrade`. |
| [`gridcraft`](components/gridcraft.md) | GridCraft, a spreadsheet application, from the official DEB that each GitHub release of [storytold/gridcraft](https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft) carries, kept up to date through the local APT bridge with plain `apt update && apt upgrade`. |
| [`herdr`](components/herdr.md) | The herdr terminal workspace manager, installed by Home Manager from the upstream herdr flake. |
| [`opencode-pi`](components/opencode-pi.md) | The OpenCode and Pi coding agents: both discover the shared skills in `~/.agents/skills`, and Pi reads the instance's agent rules. |
| [`pdfcraft`](components/pdfcraft.md) | PdfCraft, a PDF reader and editor, from the official DEB that each GitHub release of [storytold/pdfcraft](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft) carries, kept up to date through the local APT bridge with plain `apt update && apt upgrade`. |
| [`shell`](components/shell.md) | zsh as the login shell, with the starship prompt and the zsh-autosuggestions and zsh-syntax-highlighting plugins, installed by Home Manager. |
| [`vscode`](components/vscode.md) | VS Code from the vendor's official builds, its user settings file as a settings target, and optionally VS Code as the default editor. |
| [`wordcraft`](components/wordcraft.md) | WordCraft, a word processor, from the official DEB that each GitHub release of [storytold/wordcraft](https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft) carries, kept up to date through the local APT bridge with plain `apt update && apt upgrade`. |
